papers.title: Distributed Balanced Butterfly Counting in Signed Bipartite Graphs
authors: Kiran Mekala, Apurba Das, Suman Banerjee
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.21848v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The balanced butterfly is a fundamental primitive for analyzing signed bipartite graphs and provides a basis for studying higher-order structural properties, such as clustering coefficients and community structure. Despite its importance, existing approaches primarily rely on serial algorithms for balanced butterfly counting, which become inefficient on large-scale graphs. To address this limitation, we propose a distributed algorithm, D-BBC, based on a hybrid MPI+TBB framework that exploits MPI for inter-process communication and Intel TBB for intra-node parallelism.
